newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian rebels kill 26 villagers - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Algerian rebels kill 26 villagers - newspaper.

text.p: Algerian Moslem fundamentalists killed 26 villagers, including children and a pregnant woman, in two raids this week, Algeria's main Arabic language newspaper al Khabar said on Thursday.
It said 11 died in one attack and 15 in the second. Another newspaper, the independent al Watan, also reported the massacre of the 15 who died in a village near Lardjem, Tissemsilt province.
There was no official confirmation of the killings.

Al Khabar said a group of "terrorists" -- Algerian shorthand for Moslem fundamentalists -- attacked the isolated village of Jaouaza early on Tuesday, killing 15 of the inhabitants. Among them were six children and three women.
It said that earlier in the week, another group killed 11 people in a village some 50 km (30 miles) from Bechar, a provincial capital about 775 km (480 miles) southwest of Algiers.
About 60,000 people have been killed in Algeria since early 1992 when violence erupted after the authorities cancelled a general election dominated by Islamic fundamentalists.
